description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of activated parameters (expressed as a percentage of the total) and the evaluation performance in terms of PPL (Perplexity) for three different model configurations. The x-axis, labeled "Activated Parameters Ratio (%)", is a linear scale ranging from 100 to 25, with tick marks at intervals of 25. The y-axis, labeled "Eval PPL", is also a linear scale ranging from 11.5 to 14.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The legend identifies three distinct lines: a dashed red line representing "Only MoHD FFN", a solid gray line representing "Only MoHD ATTN", and a solid blue line with star markers representing "MoHD ATTN + MLP". The dashed red line remains flat at a PPL of approximately 11.6 across all values of the activated parameter ratio. The solid gray line shows a decreasing trend, starting at a PPL of approximately 11.6 at 100% activation and dropping to a PPL of about 11.4 at 50% activation, after which it remains relatively stable. The solid blue line with star markers exhibits a significant upward trend, starting at a PPL of approximately 11.6 at 100% activation and increasing sharply to a PPL of about 14.1 at 25% activation.
